dx12_fix.problem: AMD Radeon iGPU (9950X3D integrated) was Status: Error, games tried to use it instead of RTX 5090
dx12_fix.fix: Disabled AMD iGPU via PnpDevice + pnputil. Only RTX 5090 remains as OK adapter.
dx12_fix.note: Game needs restart to pick up the new adapter. DX12 on RTX 5090 = Feature Level 12.0, Compute 12.0.
